t: Index funds & ETFs: Investing in Index Funds | Charles Schwab
s: Although both aim to track indexes, index mutual funds and index ETFs differ in how they are structured, bought and sold. t: Mutual Funds | FINRA.org
s: Mutual funds pool the money of many investors, who buy shares of the funds, to purchase a range of securities to meet specified objectives, such as growth, income or both. They can offer built-in diversification and professional management but, like investing in any security, investing in a mutual fund involves certain risks.
